analysis.ablation: Full-vs-without label change, raw agreement/kappa, full-minus-without agreement with old reference and root-bootstrap CI
analysis.controls: Fixed old DeepSeek vote0 vs vote1; vote0 vs >=3of4majority of remaining round1 votes (never includes vote0); old final consensus comparison flagged circular.
analysis.cross_family_pair: Qwen vs GPT-OSS on same full-context items; no ground truth
analysis.examples: Three largest-count off-diagonal role transitions per new model; lowest versioned hash item within each transition; preserve original quote, no cherry-picking for rhetorical support
analysis.missingness: Both-valid-pair agreement/kappa plus matches/all planned; unresolved reference, invalid/missing new cases counted separately, never matches. ambiguous_other is a valid ninth role.
analysis.multiple_testing: Exploratory descriptive estimates; no confirmatory p-values or ontology acceptance thresholds
analysis.paired_gap: On same rows valid for new call, DSvote0, DSleave4, compare DSvote0-vs-leave4 agreement minus new-vs-leave4 agreement; root bootstrap, missing denominators explicit

uncertainty.interpretation: descriptive dependence-aware uncertainty over observed root blocks; no IID segment inference
uncertainty.method: percentile bootstrap resampling whole original task roots with replacement, all rows and missingness retained

annotation.effective_internal_reasoning: not independently verifiable; returned reasoning flagged and never used for labels
annotation.eligible: HTTP200, exact returned model/provider, one choice, finish_reason stop, exact six-field JSON/schema, evidence quotes literal substrings of current segment and matching anonymous source_id
annotation.preservation: Original task/current segment/max two previous segments up to1000Unicode characters copied byte-faithfully as decoded text; original Unicode offsets/provenance coordinator-side only
annotation.response_format: json_schema strict; no repair, fence stripping, quote approximation, or semantic retry
annotation.schema_probe: One fixed constructed item per route after budget approval, before study calls. Only technical schema/evidence validity gates route; predicted role never gates admission. Failure stops that route without substitution/retry.

budget.authorization_binding: Separate artifact with explicit user instruction, protocol hash, quote hash; no fabricated approval

context_intervention.interpretation: Paired label sensitivity; one call/condition cannot separate context effect from sampling variation
context_intervention.intervention: Remove previous_segments only; task/current text/ontology/transport settings identical; original inputs preserved
context_intervention.reason: All200parent items have past context; observational presence effect is unidentifiable
context_intervention.selection: Among each root's two core items, minimum SHA256([version,'ablation',item_id]),item_id

execution.live_metadata: Before first paid request: fresh exact pinned-provider metadata, active/capability/context checks and no price increase above frozen ceiling

limitations: No human reference and no E0 pass
visible text is not established internal state
different model families share one infrastructure provider; parent uses another provider
single new call versus old multiseed consensus is an asymmetric comparison
provider weight revision/quantization not independently verified
selected exposed development roots, sparse roles, no population-validity claim
research_question: Portability of functional labels of visible reasoning text across model-family annotation instruments

challenge.algorithm: Start role counts from core; among unselected items in roots not yet allocated, minimize (role_already_selected, selected_role_count, parent_role_count, SHA256([version,'challenge',item_id]),item_id), allocate its root, repeat. Unresolved reference is a category.

core.algorithm: Within root sort by SHA256(canonical([version,'core',item_id])), item_id; first two. No labels or outcomes consulted.

sampling.presentation: Core primary descriptive sample; challenge separate; pooled only explicitly enriched stress sample. No natural-role prevalence claims.
